description: The Global Coal Mine Tracker from Global Energy Monitor, a non-profit research organisation, catalogues coal mines worldwide with an emphasis on operating, inactive and proposed mines of all capacity levels, plus mines abandoned or permanently closed since 2015. On 26 September 2026 the page counted about 7,000 mines in 70 countries with 5,300 owners and 9.1 billion tonnes of coal mined per year; it identifies 835 proposals totalling 2,521 million tonnes per annum. Each mine has location, owner and parent, status, coal type, capacity, production, reserves, mine type and methane emission estimates, and links to a GEM.wiki page with sources. The latest release was August 2026, the second version of a dataset first released in May 2026; data are updated in the second quarter each year. Access is through a free tracker map and dashboard, summary tables, and a spreadsheet download after a request form. Tracker data are licensed CC-BY-4.0 unless noted. Caveats: figures come from company, government and press sources of varying quality and small mines may be missing. For simulation it is an asset inventory of coal supply sites for hazard exposure, supply disruption and energy transition planning. Related catalogue records include the Global Iron Ore Mines Tracker and the global mining polygons of Maus et al.
